card.title: Credit for the Discovery
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On tomorrow's house tour, will you say my diagram revealed the hidden doorway?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum spent all week stripping that wall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Credit her work. Then say who spotted the door before we stripped it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll let you open it for the visitors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Introduce me as the person who found it, or they'll think I'm holding it for them.

mechanism: A seeks public recognition as the hidden-door discoverer rather than allowing labor or a ceremonial role to replace credit.
confusable: Unlike a general wish to lead the tour, A must demand attribution for seeing the clue first.
comparison: Public introduction before opening a door differs from precision about a discovery verb in a written report.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
